Mona's Octoverse Arcade

Fly Mona the Octocat down the commit tunnel: ship what comes at you and dodge the bugs. Copilot is riding along with tips.

  • Commit squares: fly through them for points. Chain them for a merge combo.
  • Bugs: they come straight at you. Each hit costs a life.
  • Branch protection: a shield that blocks one bug.
  • Pull request magnet: commits come to you.

Move in every direction with arrows / WASD, or drag on the playfield. P pauses, M mutes.
